cards.name: SYS-002 — Session persistence and recovery
cards.currentSummary:
## Current core status — 23 October 2026
Saved-state validation and persistent save/recovery feedback implemented. Rejected originals remain untouched; autosave pauses; explicit recovery copies the original before replacing the main record. Save failure retains export/retry. Injected quota failure/retry, invalid boot and recovery/reload executed in isolated browser. Desktop0.1.39/source91bfe92 existing16-track startup observed22October. Analysis payload deduplication, exhaustive legacy/crash recovery and broader feature acceptance remain OPEN. Preserve analysis grid.beats reader.
